subject.title: [Feature Request]: Replace raw textarea with a structured JSON code editor (with folding support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled structured editor dependency for Control UI raw config editing, and should the existing candidate be rebuilt or replaced with a fresh PR?
rationale: The request fits web frontend ergonomics, but it adds a sizeable editor dependency and changes a sensitive raw config editing surface, so maintainer product direction is needed before a new implementation lane.

options.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
options.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only after a rebuilt or fresh PR targets current main, preserves reveal-to-edit/save semantics, and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Keep the textarea for now
options.body: Decline the dependency and UX change until raw config editing becomes a higher priority or a lighter implementation is chosen.

options.title: Request a short design note
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review dependency choice, JSON5 formatting semantics, sensitive-value handling, and proof requirements before code continues.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
recommendation.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only after a rebuilt or fresh PR targets current main, preserves reveal-to-edit/save semantics, and includes real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current reveal-to-edit raw config behavior and is the best available routing candidate for the product/dependency choice.
